question.text: <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>XeF</mi><mn>4</mn></msub></math> reacts with <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msub><mi>SbF</mi><mn>5</mn></msub></math> to form <math xmlns="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML"><msup><mfenced open="[" close="]"><msub><mi>XeF</mi><mi>m</mi></msub></mfenced><mrow><mi>n</mi><mo>+</mo></mrow></msup><msup><mfenced open="[" close="]"><msub><mi>SbF</mi><mi mathvariant="normal">y</mi></msub></mfenced><mrow><mn>2</mn><mo>-</mo></mrow></msup><mo> </mo><mi mathvariant="normal">m</mi><mo>+</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">n</mi><mo>+</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">y</mi><mo>+</mo><mi mathvariant="normal">z</mi><mo>=</mo><mo> </mo><mo> </mo><mo>?</mo></math>.

solution.text:
Xenon tetrafluoride (XeF4) is square planar and acts as a fluoride donor with SbF5. XeF4 changes to the cation XeF3+ and SbF5 changes to the anion SbF6-.

XeF4+SbF5⟶XeF3+SbF6-

 m = 3, n = 1, y = 6, z = 1
